data.action: 手扶船舷侧身回眸，毛毯拢于肩头迎风伫立
data.camera: from behind, three quarter view, cowboy shot
data.description: 夜航中破浪前行的甲板船舷旁，刺骨的夜风吹动深海风衣的衣角与及膝银发。察觉到身后走近的脚步，斯卡蒂微微侧身回眸，将肩上的毛毯稍稍拢紧，眼神中浮现出一丝难得的温和。
data.lighting: 贴壁黄铜灯照暖甲板和拢住的毛毯，冷月光照出船尾白色航迹
data.location: 罗德岛舰船外甲板船舷
data.promptProse: On the aft deck at night, Skadi looks back over one shoulder as she gathers a charcoal wool blanket in both hands and lifts it toward the collar of her dark hunter coat. Salt air lifts her long white hair. The railing runs through the middle distance above the silver wake, with a low deck lantern warming the closest boards. A rear three-quarter view leaves space beyond her to see the wake narrowing toward the horizon.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 夜航甲板的披风回眸
data.animaCaption: She looks back while drawing the plain wool blanket up with both hands behind the collar of her coat. A deck lantern warms the boards near the rail, and the broad wake is bright with moonlight astern.
